name_zh: 贝尔蒙特/秘鲁/盐/鸟粪/太平洋/战争/近代化/曼努埃尔/盐业
description_zh: 曼努埃尔·贝尔蒙特 (1844-1933) 秘鲁总统 (1915-1919) 军事独裁者，通过鸟粪经济开发太平洋资源，实施盐业现代化，领导太平洋战争，推动秘鲁资源近代化，被誉为'鸟粪总统'，推动秘鲁国家建设。
description_en: Manuel Belmonte (1844-1933) Peruvian President (1915-1919) military dictator, through bird shit economy developed Pacific resources, implemented salt industry modernization, led Pacific War, promoted Peruvian resource modernization, known as 'Bird Shit President', promoted Peruvian national construction.
reason_zh: 贝尔蒙特代表秘鲁如何利用自然资源（鸟粪）推动近代化，如何通过盐业现代化实现资源控制，以及太平洋战争如何推动秘鲁国家建设，体现了秘鲁的资源导向发展战略。
reason_en: Belmonte represents how Peru utilized natural resources (bird shit) to promote modernization, how salt industry modernization achieved resource control, and how Pacific War promoted Peruvian national construction, embodies Peru's resource-oriented development strategy.

总结资源开发遗产/秘鲁现代国家/贝尔蒙特主义
steps_en: Study Belmonte early military career/Peruvian political environment/resource consciousness
Analyze 1915 accession/bird shit economy development/salt industry modernization

Summarize resource development legacy/Peruvian modern state/Belmonteism
